key_insight: Trace-based evaluation best balances known-risk detection, while functional testing and security red-teaming uncover complementary failures.
engineering_relevance: Pair trace-based functional evaluation with adversarial security red-teaming to assess enterprise analytics agents.
method: Compare trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics.
Evaluate two analytics agents using frozen execution traces in a controlled setting.
Measure harness stability, known-risk detection, and unknown-risk discovery across three phases.
evidence_signal: 97% of configurations met the stability threshold; on 72 ground-truth cases, trace-based judging achieved F1=0.90 while text-only judging matched recall with 5× more false alarms; discovery found 24 novel failures with no overlap between functional testing and security red-teaming.
watch_item: Results from two agents and frozen traces may not generalize to live deployments with changing tools and workflows.
paper_title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
